title: Finance extremality of the L=25781 word forces an itinerary-independent empty OOE cell
statement: The unique finance-optimal two-type word at L=25781 fails after O(1) blocks because a sufficiently finance-optimal OOE/OE packing necessarily contains an OOE transition whose exact predecessor cell is empty, and that emptiness is not the existing F_2 envelope or the (2,2,1) comparison 243<256.
counterexamples: n=1000001 has a (2,1) preimage 12915515 --OOE--> 100000159 --OE--> n; 19/41 OE-realizers near 10^6 also have (2,1)
Canonical and bunched-OOE follow histograms are identical (max 6, mean 2.02); death is in the shared OOE prefix
Empty (2,2,1) into n (0/19, 0/16) is the dual of two_ooe_still_blocks_oe (243<256), not a new cell
first_seen: juggler finance-extremal word versus exact terminal cells
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exact terminal cells
notes: Phase 0 only. No Phase 2 at L=55293. No floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: F2 scan [3,20000]; terminal census stride 20 on [10^6+1,10^6+801] and [2e6+1,2e6+801]; follow on [10^6+1,10^6+2001]; coincidence on L=19,84,1054,25781
